map.根据围岩级别与开挖跨度估算初期支护与二次衬砌厚度: Estimates primary support and secondary lining thickness from the surrounding rock grade and excavation span
map.📖 查看「隧道衬砌厚度计算 使用指南」: 📖 View the Tunnel Lining Thickness Calculation user guide
map.h₂ = k · B ， k 随围岩级别 0.04~0.10: h₂ = k · B, where k = 0.04~0.10 by surrounding rock grade
map.二次衬砌厚度 h₂ 按跨度倍数估算（k=0.04~0.10，围岩越差取大值）；: The secondary lining thickness h₂ is estimated as a multiple of the span (k = 0.04~0.10, using the larger value for poorer rock);
map.初期支护喷射混凝土厚度一般 5~25cm；: primary support shotcrete thickness is generally 5~25 cm;
map.二次衬砌一般为模筑混凝土，厚度 30~60cm；: the secondary lining is generally cast-in-place concrete, 30~60 cm thick;
map.实际厚度应通过荷载-结构法或地层-结构法计算确定。: the actual thickness should be determined by a load-structure or ground-structure calculation.
map.💡 本工具为经验估算，IV级及以上围岩的二次衬砌宜按承载结构设计，并配置受力钢筋: 💡 This tool gives an empirical estimate; for grade IV and poorer rock the secondary lining should be designed as a load-bearing structure with load-carrying reinforcement; the final thickness is governed by code calculations and monitoring measurement feedback.
map.📚 深度解析：隧道衬砌厚度计算: 📚 In-depth analysis: Tunnel Lining Thickness Calculation
map.二衬厚度：按围岩级别取二次衬砌系数 k（Ⅰ级 0.04、Ⅱ级 0.05、Ⅲ级 0: Secondary lining thickness: the secondary lining coefficient k is taken by surrounding rock grade (grade I 0.04, II 0.05, III 0.06, IV 0.075, V 0.09, VI 0.10), h₂ = k × excavation span B, rounded up to 0.1 m and not less than 0.3 m; the poorer the rock, the larger k and the thicker the secondary lining.
map.厚度按围岩级别取定值（Ⅰ级 5 cm、Ⅱ级 8、Ⅲ级 12、Ⅳ级 15、Ⅴ级 2: at a thickness fixed by rock grade (grade I 5 cm, II 8, III 12, IV 15, V 20, VI 25 cm); total support thickness = primary lining thickness + secondary lining thickness.
map.配筋与工程量：Ⅳ级及以上（grade≥5）判为需配筋（钢筋混凝土），Ⅰ~Ⅲ级为素: Reinforcement and quantities: grade IV and above (grade ≥ 5) is judged to require reinforcement (reinforced concrete), grades I–III use plain concrete; the concrete volume per metre is also estimated from the secondary lining thickness as ≈ h₂ × 2 × (B + 5) m³ (perimeter approximation), for material preparation and cost estimating.
map.算例：开挖跨度 10 m 时六个围岩级别的衬砌厚度: Worked example: lining thickness for six rock grades at a 10 m excavation span
map.取 B=10 m：Ⅰ级 k=0.04 → h₂=0.4 m（40 cm），初衬: Take B = 10 m: grade I k = 0.04 → h₂ = 0.4 m (40 cm), primary lining 5 cm, total 45 cm, plain concrete, about 12.0 m³ of secondary lining per metre; grade II k = 0.05 → h₂ = 0.5 m, primary lining 8 cm, total 58 cm, about 15.0 m³; grade III k = 0.06 → h₂ = 0.6 m, primary lining 12 cm, total 72 cm, about 18.0 m³; grade IV k = 0.075 → h₂ = 0.8 m, primary lining 15 cm, total 95 cm, reinforcement required, about 24.0 m³; grade V k = 0.09 → h₂ = 0.9 m, primary lining 20 cm, total 110 cm, reinforcement required, about 27.0 m³; grade VI k = 0.10 → h₂ = 1.0 m, primary lining 25 cm, total 125 cm, reinforcement required, about 30.0 m³. The secondary lining thickens linearly as the span grows: grade IV with B = 14 m → h₂ = k × 14 = 1.05 m, rounded to 1.1 m (110 cm), total thickness 125 cm, about 41.8 m³ per metre.
map.二次衬砌厚度为什么按 k×跨度 估算，而不是按荷载计算？: Why is the secondary lining thickness estimated as k × span instead of calculated from loads?
map.k×B 是工程类比法的经验取值，把围岩级别（完整性、强度、地下水等综合分级）与开: k × B is an empirical value from the engineering analogy method: it compresses the two main factors, rock grade (a composite rating of integrity, strength, groundwater and so on) and excavation span, into a single coefficient for rapid thickness estimation and material preparation at the scheme stage. Formal design should model the structure with the load-structure or ground-structure method, including rock pressure, water pressure, seismic force and self weight, and verify the reinforcement of the secondary lining; the result of this tool cannot replace a structural calculation report.
map.Ⅳ级以上必须配筋的依据是什么，素混凝土二衬用在什么情况？: What is the basis for requiring reinforcement at grade IV and above, and when is a plain concrete secondary lining used?
map.工具按 grade≥5（Ⅳ级及以上）判为需配筋。原因是围岩较差时二衬要承担显著的: The tool judges reinforcement to be required when grade ≥ 5 (grade IV and above). The reason is that with poor rock the secondary lining must carry significant rock pressure and differential settlement, while plain concrete has low tensile strength and cracks easily. Grades I–III have strong self-supporting capacity, so the secondary lining mostly serves as a safety reserve and crack-limiting structure and may be plain concrete; but where there is unsymmetrical loading, shallow cover, a portal section or groundwater attack, reinforcement or steel-fibre concrete should be used even in better rock.
